messages:
maya: Heads up — ap-northeast-1 warm-pool join failures started ~09:12 UTC. Multiple GPU nodes stuck in PROVISIONING. Observed keystore-proxy OOMs and a lot of 503/502 egress errors.
opsbot: ALERT: keystore-proxy (infra/keystore-proxy-3) OOM at 2025-05-03T09:11:59Z — 5 restarts in 10m.
chris: Can you paste the relevant logs?
maya: Logs from keystore-proxy: ```May 03 09:11:58 keystore-proxy OOMKilled pid=4123 rss=1.9G
May 03 09:12:01 keystore-proxy ERROR upstream request failed: 503 ServiceUnavailable
May 03 09:12:04 proxy dial tcp 10.12.5.7:443: i/o timeout
May 03 09:12:10 kubelet event: Node gpu-node-7 failed to join warmpool: keystore lookup timeout```
devon: Metric dump — keystore QPS from model-evals ns spiked 3.2x at 09:10. conntrack in NAT gw at 98% used. Looks like a burst from nightly evals + a canary run.
liam: This matches the cost alarm I saw — egress + NAT gw bytes jumped. We can either: 1) throttle evals, 2) shift eval traffic to eu-west-1, or 3) bump keystore resources. Throttling is fastest. Shifting reduces pressure but increases latency for some internal customers.
maya: Short-term action: scale keystore-proxy replicas and clear cache to relieve memory pressure. Can oncall run: ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment/keystore-proxy --replicas=5 && kubectl -n infra exec deploy/keystore-proxy -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/evict-cache``` ?
sre-oncall: On it. Scaling -> 5 now. Patch rollout started, new pods becoming Ready. Calling evict-cache... done.
deploy-bot: deploy infra/keystore-proxy v2.14 rolled out -> pods 5/5 ready (09:18 UTC).
opsbot: METRIC: error-rate (keystore-proxy) -> 1.2% (was 18%) after scale. GPU warm-pool join backlog is draining; estimated full restore ~8m.
chris: Follow-up: open infra ticket to re-evaluate NAT conntrack sizing and add a circuit-breaker on eval QPS to keystore. Also add routing policy so heavy evals avoid ap-northeast when keystore is under pressure.
maya: Agreed. I'll file INFRA-3321 with proposed mitigations (conntrack bump, ephemeral keystore cache TTL=30s, eval QPS guardrail). For now leaving the scaled replicas until we validate memory footprint.
liam: Also flag finance — cost bump during incident ~+$600 last hour due to egress + warmup retries. We'll include in postmortem.
maya: TY. Quick retro tomorrow 09:30 UTC. If anyone sees errors re-emerging, ping here and escalate to P0. :eyes:
